subject: Nutrify renewal QBR — slate rotation & regional coverage
messages:
From: Jamie Ross <jamie.ross@nutrifyhealth.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 26 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Nutrify renewal QBR — consolidating demo windows

Hi Lauren,

We're starting to lock down our QBR/renewal week and want to minimize calendar churn for our execs. We have a mix of US West, Central EU, and APAC stakeholders — the ask is to compress the roadmap + tech demo into two contiguous, shorter blocks instead of three separate sessions.

Top priorities for us:
- Show the migration path and rollback story for private deployments
- See the cost/latency tradeoffs (esp. Dedicated vs Hosted) for our heavy-embedding workloads
- Short breakout for SRE to confirm audit/log access and retention

Can you propose 2x 60–75 minute windows (one morning PT-friendly, one afternoon PT-friendly that covers APAC overlap) next week? If you have a timezone matrix or suggested attendee split, please share.

Attaching the draft agenda we have. Also cc'ing Priya (procurement lead) to keep her in the loop on timing — procurement needs a Docusign window within the same week if possible.

Thanks,
Jamie
VP Product, Nutrify Health
[attachment: qbr-agenda-v2.pdf (PDF)]

From: lauren.bishop@redwood.com <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Ross <jamie.ross@nutrifyhealth.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 26 May 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Nutrify renewal QBR — consolidating demo windows

Hi Jamie — great summary, thanks.

We can do the compressed format and I agree it's the lowest-friction for execs. Proposed options (all PT):
- Option A: Wed 10:00–11:15 (PT) + Thu 14:00–15:15 (PT) — gives an APAC overlap in the Thu block
- Option B: Thu 09:00–10:15 (PT) + Thu 15:00–16:15 (PT) — single-day back-to-back with an ops buffer

I'll attach a quick timezone matrix so you can see who is covered. If one of these looks good, I'll lock speakers and follow up with Marissa for rehearsal/run-through slots.

A few quick clarifications:
- For the Dedicated vs Hosted workload comparison, would you like a side-by-side cost snapshot by token volume (we can prepare a compact chart)?
- On the audit/log ask — Karthik, can you confirm a 15-minute SRE drop-in and whether we need a separate evidence package pre-QBR?

Thanks — I'll hold the tentative times until you confirm.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Lauren / Jamie — quick note from the ops side:

- We can support both Option A and Option B. Option A gives us a little breathing room between blocks to collect logs and refresh any live demo state.
- Evidence package: we'll surface the SOC2 excerpt + retention matrix ahead of the SRE drop-in. Marissa, can you add the runbook rehearsal to the calendar once Jamie confirms the slot?
- Backup: If APAC attendance drops, we can record the Thu block and schedule a 30-min follow-up with APAC-only stakeholders next week.

One operational ask: please confirm whether Nutrify wants a recorded canary of the private deploy migration (we typically run it in a staging slice, takes ~20 minutes). If yes, we'll schedule a dry run 48 hours prior.
